Frequently Asked Questions
Can Mindbody replace my existing CRM, scheduling, and POS systems with one platform?
Yes, Mindbody can serve as a comprehensive platform that combines CRM, scheduling, and POS functionality in one system. The software includes client management features for tracking client information and relationships, robust scheduling capabilities for classes and appointments, and a complete point-of-sale system for processing transactions and managing retail products.
How can I manage my business from the Mindbody Business app?
The Mindbody Business app enables you and your staff to manage operations on the go. You can:
Add new clients, take photos, and capture signatures for liability waivers
Access client account and profile information
Browse your staff schedule
Sign clients in to classes and courses
Book, edit, and cancel appointments and check clients in
Accept payment for appointments without being at the desk
Sell products, services, and contracts
Process purchases using the same payment methods available on your Mindbody business site
Login is the same across the Business app and desktop experiences
Which third-party tools can I connect to Mindbody?
Mindbody connects with a variety of third-party tools to help you run and grow your business.
These include:
Payroll tools such as ADP, Exact Payroll, and Paychex, which let you send payroll data directly from Mindbody.
Door access systems that manage entry to your studio or gym, including turnstiles, doors, and lock hardware.
Marketing and lead generation tools like Constant Contact, Mailchimp, Perkville, Meta Ads, and Google Ads, helping you run email campaigns, loyalty programs, and digital advertising.
Additional services including Spivi (performance tracking and leaderboards), Bitlancer (late cancel and no-show fee processing),
Trainerize (digital coaching), Spafinder (gift cards), and LiveEdit (community and website tools).
How does Mindbody handle payments?
Mindbody handles payments through integrated payment processors that work directly with your software. Mindbody Payments, powered by Stripe, is a modern processing platform that allows you to accept payments through the Mindbody app, online store, or at your business location with industry-leading fraud protection and transparency into your income.
How can I automate payment issues and collections in Mindbody?
Mindbody offers several tools to help you automate parts of your payments and collections process:
You can automatically notify clients about failed or expiring payments through built-in auto emails, and use reports like Autopay Detail and Credit Card Expirations to quickly identify issues and follow up.
Chargebacks can be tracked and managed and declined autopays can be converted into account balances that you can monitor and collect.
While some actions—like responding to disputes or processing outstanding balances—still require manual steps, Mindbody streamlines most of the tracking and client communication so you can manage payment issues and collections more efficiently.
How can I track leads and manage my sales pipeline in Mindbody?
Mindbody's Lead Management includes:
Sales pipeline dashboard: View and organize leads through sales stages, with drag-and-drop functionality and automated lead capture when new profiles are created.
Follow-up tasks: Create and assign tasks to stay engaged with leads throughout the sales journey.
Sales funnel analytics: Track performance metrics to understand what's working. Third-party integrations: Connect Google Ads lead forms to automatically flow leads into your pipeline.
What's the difference between having manager and full admin permissions?
Both managers and owners share access to most daily operations like schedules, sales, and client management. The key difference is that Owners have full control over system-wide settings like user permissions, payment setup, and integrations.
Does Mindbody offer a way to manage staff schedules, substitutions, and permissions?
Yes, you can manage staff schedules, automatic substitutions, and staff permissions all within your Mindbody software.
Staff schedules: Manage class and event schedules, including assigning staff to classes and managing their appointment availability.
Automatic substitutions: The Substitution Management feature allows staff to request substitutes via text message automation.
Staff permissions: Control what staff members can access and do by setting permissions for scheduling substitutes, managing schedules, and viewing staff information.
Can Mindbody help centralize staff management across multiple locations?
Yes, Mindbody provides several features to help centralize staff management across locations:
Multi-location staff management: Manage staff across all locations from one central site with a multi-location (datashare) setup.
Staff permissions: Create customized permission groups that can be assigned to staff members across your network. With Ultimate pricing packages, you can individually customize and assign permissions by group.
Staff login locations: Control which locations staff members can access and work from within your system.
IP restrictions: Set up IP restrictions to ensure staff can only log in from specific locations, like your business locations, rather than personal devices.
What types of reports and dashboards can I use to monitor my business?
Mindbody offers a range of reports and dashboards to track performance across sales, clients, staff, and marketing. You can monitor revenue, attendance, payroll, retention, and lead conversion, plus view key metrics in real time through customizable dashboards and automated report delivery.
How can I access centralized reports for multiple locations in Mindbody?
Depending on your business needs, Mindbody offers comprehensive multi-location management through two main setup options.
For Enterprise Solutions, you get network-wide control with a corporate dashboard that provides a complete view of all regions and locations. This includes corporate-level reporting with business intelligence dashboards, cross-location reports on sales, clients, and visits, and year-over-year revenue metrics.
For smaller businesess, the datashare (multi-location) setup is ideal for locations that are close together and where clients frequently move between those locations. Mindbody software shows shared services, pricing, clients, and staff for multiple locations, while each location has its own dropdown menu for location-specific management.
Can I schedule and automate reports to be delivered regularly in Mindbody?
Yes, you can schedule and automate reports in Mindbody. Reports are emailed automatically to specified recipients, with daily, weekly, or monthly delivery.
Can waivers or forms be required and signed digitally using Mindbody?
Yes, but there's some nuance. Forms and waives are two separate tools, and here's how they work:
Forms: Can be required (often per service) and can include a digital signature—including stylus signature in supported flows.
Waivers: Can be required and are typically completed as a digital acknowledgment (like a checkbox) with a timestamp during booking, account creation, or at the front desk in the BizApp. Note: signature behavior can vary by flow.
With Mindbody, you can collect the right paperwork at the right moment, so check-in stays fast, your staff stays focused, and clients get to the good part sooner.
Not all features are available in all regions or on all tiers. Quoted statistics are not guaranteed.

Blog Post
Mindbody Reviews: What Users Are Really Saying About Mindbody
By Ma-Keba Frye
Share:
Table of contents
Is Mindbody expensive?
Is Mindbody easy to use?
Is Mindbody worth it for small businesses?
Can Mindbody help your business grow?
How is Mindbody's customer support?
So, is Mindbody worth it overall?
About the author
Unlock your potential with a partner in growth
Get started
Last updated: September 24, 2026
Key Takeaways
Mindbody's customer support is a top reason fitness and wellness business owners use the platform. Every plan includes one-on-one onboarding, built to prevent problems before they start.
Fitness and wellness business owners describe Mindbody as intuitive to learn. Mindbody's interface makes daily operations smooth and efficient.
Reviewers who call Mindbody's pricing higher than alternatives still state that it's worth the cost once they factor in reduced fees, bundled marketing tools, or years of value.
Beyond general ease-of-use praise, reviewers call out specific capabilities: dynamic availability-based pricing, contactless payments, and ClassPass integration as reasons they stay with Mindbody. That echoes Mindbody's own emphasis on discoverability and payment tools as growth drivers.
What do studio, spa, and salon owners really think of Mindbody? We combed through reviews on Capterra , G2 , and Trustpilot to find out.
Is Mindbody expensive?
Mindbody's entry-level plan starts at $79 USD a month per location in the US. At this new entry price, the platform offers one of the most competitive prices for small businesses with more than one staff member and is considerably less than the cost of running scheduling, marketing, payment processing, and reporting as separate tools. Mindbody customers say the price reflects long-term value, not just a monthly cost. Reviewers most often point to two things: marketing tools bundled in instead of billed separately, and competitive pricing that delivers strong value for money.
"I started with Mindbody in 2008 at $65/month... Granted, the price is no longer $65/month, but it is competitive and gives better value and a bigger bang for my buck." (Jonathan)
"Despite its higher price point, the comprehensive nature and the compelling value proposition of Mindbody make it a worthy investment, even for multiple locations." (Jen)
"I also love that there is a marketing feature I can take advantage of to send out communications to our members, without having to pay for a separate service." (Andrea)
Is Mindbody easy to use?
Mindbody is built around the tasks fitness and wellness businesses already run each day: scheduling , check-ins , payments , and reporting . Customers often describe Mindbody as intuitive and easy to navigate, even when managing scheduling, memberships, payments, and reporting all at once. Many Mindbody reviewers say setup is simple, especially with guided onboarding to help them get started. They also say the platform is easy to use during busy periods.
"The platform is easy to navigate, professional, and makes managing a fitness business much more organized. From scheduling classes and managing memberships to keeping everything in one place, it simplifies a lot of the day-to-day work." ( Ivan )
"I love how Mindbody feels intuitive and is super user-friendly. It keeps me organized, focused, and accurate with headcounts, and it allows me to mark students as missed. I enjoy being able to generate reports as needed and see students' reviews on my classes, so new students know what to expect. The star ratings, along with my picture and bio, are features I appreciate. Also, setting up Mindbody was super simple." ( Lucia )
"Mindbody keeps all of our scheduling, client management, sales, and reporting in one organized system. It is very easy for our staff to use, even during busy periods, and the interface makes daily operations smooth and efficient. " ( Ali )
"We use Mindbody for our entire business, and it's been a really easy application to use. The reservation system is particularly beneficial because it helps us track who's signing up for certain classes, which allows us to staff accordingly. We also find it very helpful for our daycare system as it helps track what kids are going to come in, so we know how many staff members we need. Tracking spending and credit cards has been really simple with Mindbody, and whenever we have to call or have an issue, they are very responsive and reliable. Adding new staff to clock in and out has been very simple." ( Kaya )
Is Mindbody worth it for small businesses?
Mindbody customers consistently describe the platform as a good fit for a small business to run and grow on. Starting at $79 a month, Mindbody's entry-level plan is a complete, affordable solution that covers scheduling, billing, CRM, and financial management in one system, features small businesses would otherwise pay for separately. They also credit the Mindbody Business app and ClassPass integration for simple check-ins and new client acquisition.
"I have owned and operated my own private training studio for 8 years in that time I have utilized Mindbody's software the entire time. Prior to stating my own business I used many other systems and not only have I been happy but in the time that I have been them the product has only improved. Mindbody has helped track my clients sessions effortlessly. It gives me in my small business more than enough options to make changes to my billing and schedule easily." ( Samantha )
" Mindbody is a great platform to run a small fitness business as it integrates the scheduling, CRM, billing and financial management tools. The mobile app is very user friendly for check in and also to sign up clients while not at a desk. The [ClassPass] integration and the connection with other fitness apps makes it easy to acquire clients via these other subscription offerings." ( Matthieu )
Can Mindbody help your business grow?
Mindbody customers say the platform helps them attract more clients and earn more revenue, not just stay organized. Reviewers credit Mindbody's support team for sharing platform knowledge that directly helps their studios grow. They also point to specific growth features, like dynamic pricing that adjusts to class availability and built-in marketing tools that reach a wider audience without relying on third-party services. Mindbody's reporting and analytics make it easy to track business performance and spot new opportunities for growth.
"We have been very pleased about the work we have done together - lots of new knowledge about the platform which helps us grow as a studio." ( Monica )
"Ben and Emily have both been so much help to me. They are both very knowledgeable and helpful with any of the questions I've put forth. They've made my everyday use of [Mindbody] a much more pleasurable experience and the information is definitely helping me grow my business!" ( Jeannie )
"Overall, it has all the features a business could need to run smoothly and continue to grow. Lots of different options all in one software. Extensive features to grow business. Good scheduling options. Easy to use with lots of tutorials and customer support options." ( Tamsin )
" I find Mindbody to be a unified and comprehensive platform that effectively supports running my studio. Its well-known status in the industry and the community around it provide me with a robust network of shared knowledge and support. I particularly appreciate its dynamic pricing capabilities, which intelligently adjust according to class availability, thereby maximizing revenue potential without relying on third-party services. The platform's ability to market offers online effectively aids in reaching a wider audience. Additionally, the analytics features are invaluable as they offer a straightforward way to comprehend business operations and identify potential opportunities for growth." ( Jen )
How is Mindbody's customer support?
Support is a common highlight in Mindbody reviews, with customers often describing the team as helpful and easily available, even when they only need to reach out occasionally. Some reviewers describe Mindbody's support team as thorough and knowledgeable, walking them through setup or troubleshooting step by step. Other Mindbody customers point to consistent follow-up, noting that issues come with a recap email confirming what was fixed. One reviewer, a five-year customer, calls Mindbody's support top notch and says the team takes the time to actually understand the issue.
"I use Mindbody for scheduling appointments and find it helps me keep my scheduling organized. I like the scheduling and payment collection features, as they allow me to collect and record cash or credit card payments. The AI help often works well for me, helping me find answers about 50% or 60% of the time. When I need to contact support, they are always helpful and responsive. Setting up Mindbody was pretty easy for me because I had help." ( Deanna )
"Overall, I have been with Mindbody for over five years and am impressed with their continued growth in offering more features over the years. Customer support is top notch. Easily available and works to understand your issue. There is always follow-up by email afterwards to recap the issue and solution." ( Chris )
"[Josselin] was incredibly helpful in guiding me through the Mindbody app! She was patient, kind, knowledgeable, and made the whole process so much easier to understand. I really appreciated her time and willingness to walk me through everything. Great customer service!"( Kim )
"Wensley was my customer support representative. He was incredibly helpful. I could not have gotten through the software learning process without him. He was thorough, patient, and pleasant. We had three zoom meetings. I would be happy to work with him again on any future needs that I have to learn more about [Mindbody]." ( JD )
So, is Mindbody worth it overall?
Mindbody customers across Capterra, G2, and Trustpilot describe the same four qualities: ease of use, value for price, all-in-one functionality, and responsive support. The Mindbody platform is easy to use, especially for staff managing scheduling, payments, and reporting during busy periods. Additionally, Mindbody is worth the price, with an accessible starting cost that includes tools businesses would otherwise pay for separately. As a complete platform, Mindbody combines scheduling, billing, CRM, marketing, and analytics in one system instead of several. And Mindbody's customer support is consistently described as helpful, responsive, and easy to reach.
Taken together, these reviews point to one answer: Mindbody is worth it for small fitness and wellness businesses that want a complete platform to run and grow their business.

Your Privacy Choices
Last updated:
April 27, 2026
"Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" and "Targeted Advertising" Opt-Out Rights
Sale, Sharing, and Targeted Advertising
Certain states provide residents or their authorized agents with the right to opt-out of:
the "selling" or "sharing" of their personal information, or
"targeted advertising" using their personal information.
Many of these states define "sale" as disclosing or making available personal information to a third-party in exchange for monetary or other valuable consideration. California defines "sharing" as disclosing or making available personal information to a third-party for purposes of cross-contextual behavioral advertising, and states that provide for a right to opt-out of "targeted advertising" define that term as similar to California's definition of "sharing."
While we do not disclose personal information to third parties in exchange for monetary compensation, we may be considered "selling" or "sharing" personal information due to our use of ad and analytics cookies and other tools. We "sell" or "share" the following categories of personal information: identifiers and internet or other electronic network activity information. We disclose these categories to third-party advertising networks, analytics providers, and social networks for purposes of marketing and advertising. We do not sell or share personal information about individuals we know are under 16.
Opt-Out
To submit a request to opt out of targeted advertising, or the sale or sharing of your personal information, or to adjust your previously-set preferences, please click on the following links:
If you are a visitor to Mindbody's business/corporate website www.mindbodyonline.com , view Mindbody preferences here .
If you are a visitor to Booker's business/corporate website www.booker.com , view Booker preferences here .
If you are a visitor to Mindbody's consumer site www.mindbodyonline.com/explore , view Mindbody consumer preferences here .
You also have the right to opt-out through the use of an opt-out preference signal. If our website detects that your browser or device is transmitting an opt-out preference signal, such as the "global privacy control"—or GPC—signal, we will opt that browser or device out of cookies on our website that result in a sale or sharing of your personal information, or targeted advertising using your personal information.
Please note that your opt-out choice is specific to the website or subdomain you are browsing and to the device and browser you are using. If you access our other websites or subdomains, you will need to make a separate choice, or use an opt-out preference signal, for each. Additionally, if you clear your cookies on your browser or use another browser or device, you may need to opt out again.
You or your authorized agent may also opt-out by sending an email to [email protected] .
More Information
For more information about how we collect and use personal information, please see the Mindbody Privacy Policy .

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the best management software for my fitness, wellness, or beauty business?
Mindbody is the best management software for fitness, beauty, and wellness businesses because it gives small businesses everything they need to run and grow starting at just $79 USD/mo and handles the added complexity as they scale.
Starting at $79 USD/month (North America and Asia), Mindbody's plans include self-serve booking, integrated payments, automated reminders and confirmations, reporting, branded booking widgets, and a Customized Website . Plus, growth features like dynamic pricing, intro offers, ClassPass integration, and unmatched exposure: a listing on the Mindbody app, where 3M+ consumers are actively searching for fitness, beauty, and wellness services every month.
Mindbody also offers robust features that automate your to-do list while helping you grow: AI Concierge, an AI-powered front desk that answers client questions and handles bookings and rescheduling for you, automated email and SMS marketing, a branded mobile app, and advanced multi-location reporting.
How do Mindbody's subscription prices compare to other management software options?
Mindbody's entry-level plan starts at $79 USD/month (North America and Asia), with no fees for additional users, and gives small businesses the features and tools they need to run and grow. Other software providers like WellnessLiving and Vagaro may advertise lower entry prices, but they cap those prices at a single staff member. This means that for businesses with more than one staff member, or those planning to hire, this per-staff structure can make costs rise—exceeding Mindbody's total cost.
It's also worth noting that at the $79 entry price, Mindbody offers businesses a Customized Website . Providers like Glofox, Mangomint, and MarianaTek don't advertise a website solution, meaning extra cost and work to source one elsewhere. Providers that do offer websites, like WellnessLiving and Vagaro, charge significant extra monthly and setup fees on top of their base price.
How do Mindbody's payment processing fees compare to other wellness management software?
If you choose to use Mindbody Payments , a payment processing rate plus a fixed fee of $0.10 to $0.30 (in North America and Asia) will apply per transaction. The rate varies based on whether the transaction is card-present or card-not-present, and by payment type used, which is standard across the payment industry.
Other management software providers charge fees on top of standard transaction rates. According to WellnessLiving's help center , they charge additional gateway, maintenance, and PCI compliance fees, while Arketa adds a flat platform fee per transaction in their entry tier.
I'm a small business owner. Is Mindbody worth it?
For small businesses, Mindbody offers a complete and affordable solution at a new, lower price of $79 USD/month (North America and Asia).
Automated reminders and confirmations, late cancellation and no-show fees, and automatic membership renewals all work together to protect revenue that could otherwise be lost. Self-serve booking and integrated payments remove manual admin work, freeing up your time so you can focus on clients. Plus, a listing on the Mindbody app puts your business in front of 3M+ consumers already searching for services like yours.
Just as important: Mindbody has advanced tools that are built to scale with your business as it grows. You never have to migrate platforms, retrain staff, or rebuild your booking flow from scratch.
Who is Mindbody a good fit for?
Mindbody is a good fit for beauty, fitness, and wellness businesses at three stages: small businesses and solo entrepreneurs that are looking for a complete system at an affordable price of $79 USD/month (in North America and Asia), growing businesses that want to attract and keep more clients, and multi-location businesses that need to run everything from one platform.
Mindbody may not be a fit for independent, one-person operators who rent time at a shared location and only need basic booking and payment solutions.
What support is included with Mindbody? Is there a setup fee?
There's no onboarding fee on any Mindbody plan. Every customer gets dedicated one-on-one support for software setup, at no additional cost, so they're set up correctly for maximum growth.
Support doesn't stop once your business is live on Mindbody, either. Mindbody's AI Assistant provides instant, around-the-clock answers whenever you need them—no waiting on hold. If you'd rather learn at your pace, the Learning Center offers on-demand tutorials and trainings, and our support center has step-by-step instructions for every feature. Prefer to speak with a person to get support? You can also reach the Mindbody team by phone, chat, or email 24/7.
What is the Mindbody app? Does it have fees?
The Mindbody app is an exclusive marketplace available to Mindbody customers on all plans. The Mindbody app provides businesses with exposure and reach unmatched in wellness management software: a marketing channel seen by 3M+ consumers searching for fitness, beauty, and wellness services.
Listing your business on the Mindbody app is free. If an existing client books through the app, came through a tracked referral link, or identifies you as how they found your business, there's no fee for their booking. A fee applies only when the app delivers a client you wouldn't have received otherwise. The fee is 20%, capped at $30 USD (or 30 in local currency), and only on the first purchase for someone new to your business. Every booking after the first is commission-free. This is a fraction of what most businesses typically spend to acquire a new client through paid marketing, and unlike ad spend, you only pay when it results in a booked client.
Do I have to use Mindbody's payment processing solution?
No, Mindbody does not require you to use its payment processing, Mindbody Payments, to run your business on the software. You can use Mindbody with a third-party payment processor of your choice. Some promotional offers include Mindbody Payments as part of the package.
Mindbody Payments is available on every plan and runs inside the same system you already use to schedule, sell, and manage clients. A third-party processor means a separate login, separate reporting, and reconciling two sets of records at the end of the day. With Mindbody Payments, every sale, membership charge, and refund shows up in one place alongside the rest of your business data. Because payments are built in, clients can check out and save a card on file in one step, memberships bill automatically each cycle, and late-cancel and no-show fees are charged automatically under your cancellation policy.
Does Mindbody offer email and text messaging?
All of Mindbody's plans include unlimited booking confirmations and reminders by email. On Accelerate plans and above, customers get unlimited booking confirmations and reminders by text and email. Want access to full email and text marketing campaigns? Mindbody's Ultimate plan includes automated email and text marketing, with a monthly text bundle. Need more? Additional texts are a fraction of a cent each (or local equivalent), so scaling your marketing efforts is predictable and affordable.
Does Mindbody charge per additional users?
Mindbody doesn't charge a fee for additional users of the software. Unlike other wellness management providers, Mindbody customers get unlimited users per location in all plans. Subscription prices increase based on new locations, but not by adding new staff to existing locations.
What additional services are available in my Mindbody plan?
Every Mindbody plan comes with hands-on 1:1 onboarding and 24/7 support built in, so businesses are never on their own. Beyond that, Mindbody helps your business grow in ways that go beyond what some platforms offer:
Capital (available in the US, CA, UK, and AU) : Get the funding your business needs with Mindbody Capital—fast, simple financing with pre-approved or pre-qualified offers in your software. Apply in a few clicks with no credit check and, if approved, receive funds within days. Eligibility is based on your performance on the Mindbody platform.
Insurance (available in the US, excl. Alaska and Hawaii) : Get connected to coverage built specifically for wellness businesses. Pay only for what you need, with tailored policies and comprehensive coverage so you can thrive without compromise.
For larger or growing operations, Mindbody offers premium implementation, custom data conversion, and dedicated Technical Account Management . These are priced separately from your plan, so you only pay for what you add-on.
How long does Mindbody setup and onboarding typically take? Which steps are handled by my team vs. Mindbody?
As a new Mindbody customer, your exact "go-live" timeline depends on a few things, like how quickly you can meet with us, share your setup details, and provide any data to migrate.
No matter your business size, Mindbody offers dedicated one-on-one sessions with an onboarding specialist to help set you up for success. Here's what Mindbody handles for you: software configuration based on your business needs, which includes data migration, tailored training sessions built around your day-to-day workflows, and access to self-serve tools like the Learning Center and AI Assistant , as well as webinars and training recordings you can revisit anytime.
Here's what your team handles: sharing your business basics (services/classes, pricing, and booking policies) so we can set up your software, providing client lists and any other data that needs to be transferred, and training your staff.
Am I locked into a contract with Mindbody? What is the process for cancellation?
Your Mindbody contract depends on the specific plan and billing terms you signed up for, including any promotions applied. Cancellation is typically handled through your Mindbody account or through Customer Support and may require advance notice based on your agreement (for example, canceling before your next billing date).
Is it easy to switch to Mindbody from my current software?
Yes, switching to Mindbody is designed to be easy and seamless. We offer a data transfer service (fees may apply) that can move your existing setup, client information, and other data from your previous system, so you don't have to worry about manual data entry. Our team is here to help you every step of the way to ensure a smooth transition.
Is my data safe and secure with Mindbody?
Yes, data security is a top priority at Mindbody. We employ numerous redundant data safety systems and follow strict PCI compliance procedures to ensure that all of our subscribers' data, including your clients' credit card information, receive rigorous, industry standard protection.
